invariants.description: second law: every reaction runs down its affinity, v A >= 0, so P_diss >= 0
invariants.expr: np.all(v_HK*A_HK >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_HK).max()*np.abs(A_HK).max()) and np.all(v_PGI*A_PGI >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_PGI).max()*np.abs(A_PGI).max()) and np.all(v_PFK*A_PFK >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_PFK).max()*np.abs(A_PFK).max()) and np.all(v_ALD*A_ALD >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_ALD).max()*np.abs(A_ALD).max()) and np.all(v_TPI*A_TPI >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_TPI).max()*np.abs(A_TPI).max()) and np.all(v_GAPDH*A_GAPDH >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_GAPDH).max()*np.abs(A_GAPDH).max()) and np.all(v_PGK*A_PGK >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_PGK).max()*np.abs(A_PGK).max()) and np.all(v_PGM*A_PGM >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_PGM).max()*np.abs(A_PGM).max()) and np.all(v_ENO*A_ENO >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_ENO).max()*np.abs(A_ENO).max()) and np.all(v_PK*A_PK >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_PK).max()*np.abs(A_PK).max()) and np.all(v_LDH*A_LDH >= -1e-12*np.abs(v_LDH).max()*np.abs(A_LDH).max()) and np.all(P_diss >= -1e-9*np.abs(P_diss).max())

invariants.description: NAD+ and NADH are made and used only here: their sum is conserved (relative 1e-9)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(C_NAD + C_NADH, C_NAD[0] + C_NADH[0], rtol=1e-9, atol=0)

invariants.description: the ports report each chemostat's net production: j_glc = -v_HK, j_lac = v_LDH, j_ATP = -v_HK - v_PFK + v_PGK + v_PK (exact)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(j_glc, -v_HK, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(j_lac, v_LDH, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(j_ATP, -v_HK - v_PFK + v_PGK + v_PK, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-30)

bc_sweep.rationale: glucose from starving to a meal; ATP and ADP from a de-energised to a resting cell; Pi and lactate over an order of magnitude; pH 6.8 to 8
